root_text:
HPMV versus COVID..

HMPV is not a new virus. Has been there for a long time and we have seen it previously too. We are expected to have some immunity due to past infections. COVID 19 was a new virus with no previous exposures/immunity. Hen

nodes.text:
HPMV versus COVID..

HMPV is not a new virus. Has been there for a long time and we have seen it previously too. We are expected to have some immunity due to past infections. COVID 19 was a new virus with no previous exposures/immunity. Hence unlikely to be as aggressive.

nodes.text:
@Parvaizkoul But sir I heard it is infecting small kids more than elder people and do kids have good immunity. 
#HMPVinIndia

nodes.author: Parvaizkoul
nodes.text: @javaidbanday Can cause bronchiolitis in children and infants and routine respiratory infections and pneumonia in older adults and those with immunocompromise. On a community level we would be better off as a result of previous infection. This why it hits these subgroups where immunity is low.
